nodes.prompt:
Round 9 of 10: Dynamic Layout Algorithms, Macro Automation, Audio Sonification & Multi-Agent Presence Overlay

### Objective:
Implement four state-of-the-art layout, automation, accessibility, and multi-agent presence capabilities in GVUI:
1. Hybrid Dynamic Force-Directed & Hierarchical Sugiyama DAG Layout Engine (`src/engine/layout/`, `src/store/useLayoutStore.ts`)
2. Interactive Canvas Macro Recorder & Batch Action Playback Engine (`src/components/MacroRecorder/`, `src/engine/macros/`)
3. Accessible Canvas Sonification, Screen Reader ARIA & Audio Cue Engine (`src/engine/audio/`, `src/components/AccessibilitySettings/`)
4. Real-Time Multi-Agent Live Cursor & Presence Canvas Overlay (`src/engine/GraphCanvas/collaboration/`, `src/store/usePresenceStore.ts`)

### Strict Invariants:
- 100% test coverage with zero TypeScript `any` annotations or casts.
- 1-round adversarial stress-test gauntlet before approval (`min_adversarial_rejections: 1`).
- Pristine UI/UX with smooth micro-interactions, dark/light theme support, and zero layout shift.
